In detail

Della Vittoria (also called Delle Vittorie), around Piazza Mazzini and toward Ponte Milvio, is a quiet, middle-class residential quarter of early-20th-century apartment blocks, tree-lined streets and local shops. Searches of current Italian press turned up local governance and neighborhood-association coverage about traffic and livability, but no documented incidents of violent crime, drug dealing or public-order problems specific to this zone. No specific safety concerns documented in recent local press for this area.
